text:
sam_sales: Quick POV request from prospect (Orion Lending). They want BYO-KMS + HSM-proxy in their VPC. Two asks: (A) emergency key rotation/evict must be <=4 minutes, (B) invoice must show per-HSM-call line items. Need feasibility check and sample SOW language.

nina_se: Clarify: eviction of new writes within 4m, or full revoke preventing old-wraps globally in 4m?

sam_sales: They want new writes to use new keys within 4m; historical reads can continue for 24h.

arthur_eng: Feasible if we: force cache invalidation, push new wrapping keys to proxies, and optionally shorten TLS session TTLs. Tradeoffs: short-lived sessions increase CPU and may spike 95th latencies during flush. Expect transient errors ~30-60s if we force purge.

maya_sre: Runbook sketch: 1) create new key in customer KMS 2) push to HSM proxy cluster 3) invalidate local caches + restart key worker 4) switch traffic to new key 5) monitor error spike + auto-rollback threshold. Canary window 45s recommended.

deepa_security: Security requirements: attestation document for HSM, signed audit trail of rotation, and if they want M-of-N import ceremony that adds lead time. Also confirm FIPS/CC requirements. Link to questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec/byo-kms (internal).

rachel_finance: Billing: per-call line OK but needs metering tag. We can create SKU BYO-HSM_CALL and show separate line items: (1) Monthly commit, (2) HSM-call overage. What price are they expecting?

sam_sales: They floated $0.011/call with a monthly commit to drop to $0.004/call above 3M.

arthur_eng: Cost sanity: $0.011 plausible at low volume; at high bursts better to use commits. Also need to account for extra telemetry for per-call counting.

maya_sre: Networking: prefer VPC peering over NAT for stability. Firewall: allow outbound 443 to proxy pool and maintain a static egress IP list. I'll paste a starter terraform snippet in follow-up.

deepa_security: SOW language suggestion: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to begin serving new write requests under newly-rotated keys within four (4) minutes of rotation initiation. Emergency revocation may cause transient elevated error rates; Redwood will notify Customer and provide signed rotation audit artifacts on request." Add clause about exceptions for network partition.

rachel_finance: If they want a firm SLA replace "commercially reasonable efforts" with a measurable target (e.g., "90% of new write requests in the customer's primary region will use new keys within 4 minutes"), but legal will add carve-outs.

sam_sales: Good. Next steps: (1) Arthur -> short latency/error matrix for forced purge vs staged (50/300/800 rps) (2) Maya -> network template + egress IP list (3) Deepa -> exact doc checklist for attestation/ceremony (4) Rachel -> draft invoice sample with SKU lines. I'll schedule a 15m call with Orion after we have these.

billing-bot: Note: feature flag per-call-metering enabled in canary. PR #5060 created.

sam_sales: Thanks team 44d. I'll loop in legal for SOW verbiage once drafts are up.
